T: Two yutes walk into a diner.
D: A Brooklyn mechanic turned lawyer defends his cousin in a small Alabama town.
P: Serve breakfast during the grits cross-examination.
S: the grits cross-examination, nobody can cook them that fast
Stone-ground grits whisked into boiling salted milk and water, stirred low for 25 minutes until creamy. Finish with butter and sharp cheddar.
Slice green tomatoes 1cm, salt 10 minutes, dip in buttermilk then seasoned cornmeal, fry at 180C. Remoulade of mayo, mustard, capers and hot sauce.
the diner where Vinny tries to order breakfast
Grated frozen butter into self-raising flour, buttermilk, fold and cut, bake at 220C. Brown sausage meat, add flour, then milk, simmer thick with plenty of pepper.
M: the corner store where the whole mess started
Pound thin steaks, dredge in seasoned flour, buttermilk, flour again, shallow-fry until crisp. Cream gravy from the pan with flour, milk and black pepper.
Vinny's hunting trip with the DA
Brown venison or beef mince with onion, garlic and capsicum, add chilli powder, cumin, tomato and kidney beans, simmer 90 minutes. Cornbread alongside.
W: Wazoo, Alabama, ticking clock and all
Juicy blackberries baked under a soft biscuit topping, served warm with cream. Toss 750g blackberries with 100g sugar and 1 tbsp cornflour in a dish.
K: Southern style in Wazoo, Alabama, so sweet your teeth hurt

Strong black tea sweetened with fresh peach syrup and lemon, poured over ice with peach slices and mint. Simmer 2 sliced ripe peaches with 120g caster sugar and 150ml water for 10 minutes, mash lightly and strain, keeping the syrup. Steep 6 black tea bags in 1 litre just-boiled water for 5 minutes and remove. Stir in the peach syrup and juice of half a lemon, then chill for 2 hours. Serve over ice with fresh peach slices and mint.

steps.text: Bring the milk, water and salt to the boil.
Whisk in the grits, then stir over low heat until creamy. It takes much longer than five minutes.
Finish with the butter and cheddar.

dishes.make_ahead: Fry to serve; remoulade up to 1 day ahead

ingredients.item: salt and pepper, for the cornmeal

steps.text: Slice the tomatoes 1cm thick, salt and leave for 10 minutes, then pat dry.
Dip in buttermilk, then in seasoned cornmeal.
Shallow-fry at 180C for 2 minutes a side in batches.
Mix the mayonnaise, mustard, capers and hot sauce for the remoulade.

ingredients.item: self-raising flour, extra for the gravy

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Grate the frozen butter into the 300g self-raising flour with a pinch of salt and toss to coat.
Stir in the buttermilk to make a soft dough, fold it over on itself three times, pat out 2cm thick and cut 8 biscuits.
Bake the biscuits on a lined tray until risen and golden.
Squeeze the sausage meat out of the skins and brown it in a frying pan, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the extra flour for a minute, then add the milk a little at a time and simmer until thick, with plenty of black pepper. Split the biscuits and spoon the gravy over.
Pound the steaks very thin.
Dredge in seasoned flour, dip in buttermilk, then flour again.
Shallow-fry 3 minutes a side until crisp.
Pour off most of the oil, stir the gravy flour into the pan, whisk in the milk and simmer thick with lots of black pepper.
Serve over the mashed potato.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 4 hours ahead; serve warm

steps.text: Toss the blackberries with the sugar and cornflour in a dish.
Rub the butter into the flour and sugar, add the milk and drop spoonfuls on top.
Bake at 190C for 35 minutes.
Serve with cream.

ingredients.item: ripe peaches, sliced, plus 1 for serving

steps.text: Simmer the peaches with the sugar and water for 10 minutes, mash lightly and strain, keeping the syrup.
Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes and remove.
Stir in the peach syrup and lemon juice and chill for 2 hours.
Serve over ice with fresh peach slices and mint.

edition.tagline: Two yutes walk into a diner.
edition.cue: Serve breakfast during the grits cross-examination.

s.note: the grits cross-examination, nobody can cook them that fast
s.how: Bring 500ml milk and 500ml water to the boil with 1 tsp salt. Whisk in 150g stone-ground grits or polenta, then stir over low heat for 25 minutes until creamy. Finish with 40g butter and 80g grated sharp cheddar. Not five minutes, whatever anyone says.

Slice 3 green tomatoes 1cm thick, salt and leave 10 minutes, then pat dry. Dip in 150ml buttermilk, then 120g fine cornmeal seasoned with salt and pepper, and shallow-fry at 180C for 2 minutes a side. Mix 100g mayonnaise, 1 tsp mustard, 1 tbsp chopped capers and a dash of hot sauce for the remoulade.

m.note: the corner store where the whole mess started
m.how: Pound 4 minute steaks, about 600g, very thin. Dredge in seasoned flour, dip in 200ml buttermilk, then flour again, and shallow-fry 3 minutes a side until crisp. Pour off most of the oil, stir 2 tbsp flour into the pan, whisk in 400ml milk and simmer thick with lots of black pepper. Serve over 800g mashed potato.

w.note: Wazoo, Alabama, ticking clock and all
w.how: Toss 750g blackberries with 100g sugar and 1 tbsp cornflour in a dish. Rub 80g butter into 200g self-raising flour and 50g sugar, add 150ml milk and drop spoonfuls on top. Bake at 190C for 35 minutes and serve with 300ml cream.

d.note: Strong black tea sweetened with fresh peach syrup and lemon, poured over ice with peach slices and mint.
d.how: Simmer 2 sliced ripe peaches with 120g caster sugar and 150ml water for 10 minutes, mash lightly and strain, keeping the syrup. Steep 6 black tea bags in 1 litre just-boiled water for 5 minutes and remove. Stir in the peach syrup and juice of half a lemon, then chill for 2 hours. Serve over ice with fresh peach slices and mint.
